summary: Iteration 2 retest of the iteration_1 fixes. Backend: 30/31 pytest pass (13 existing + 17 new in test_iteration2_fixes.py with 1 failure). These all work: past-date booking returns 400, inactive barber returns 400, duration-aware 409 conflicts, /horarios with servico_id, rebooking after a cancel (the partial index works), status transitions where Realizado and Cancelado are final, cliente can only cancel own bookings, role validation, clearing barbeiro_id on demotion, admin self-demote blocked, delete with active bookings returns 409, /agendamentos/me sorted ascending, barbeiros galeria, product images return 200. One real bug: slot_span ignores the lunch gap. Frontend (390x844 web preview): all requested flows were checked and pass. No deprecated Expo packages were found and there are no window.confirm or prompt calls.

minor.issue: slot_span() takes the next entries of DEFAULT_SLOTS, so a 60-min service at 11:30 spans [11:30, 13:00]. The service runs into the lunch break (12:00-13:00), and the 11:30 slot is offered as available. It also wrongly blocks 13:00. Reproduce: GET /api/horarios?servico_id=<60min> returns 11:30 disponivel=true. Fix: build the span from real times (start + k*30min) and require each one to be in DEFAULT_SLOTS. Reference: server.py:635-641
duracao_minutos is stored in the DB but missing from the response model, so the frontend cannot show the booking duration or end time.
status is a free string (no Literal['Ativo','Inativo']). preco, estoque and duracao_minutos accept negative values (no Field(ge=0) / gt=0).
The index only guards the start slot. Two concurrent overlapping multi-slot bookings (for example 14:00/60min and 14:30) can still race past the occupied_slots check. Low risk.

ui_bugs.issue: nextAg uses a.data >= today with no time check. A Pendente booking from earlier today (for example 09:00 when it is now 20:00) still shows 'seu horário é hoje às 09:00'.

issues: Prices use toFixed(2) with a dot ('R$ 45.00', 'R$ 25.50'). The pt-BR format is 'R$ 45,00' (use toLocaleString('pt-BR', {style:'currency', currency:'BRL'})). Affects booking.tsx:119,207, admin/servicos.tsx:16, admin/produtos.tsx:16, admin/index.tsx:41 and the catalog.
The slot grid uses 3 fixed-width 76px chips and leaves empty space on the right at 375px. Use 4 columns or flex-basis so the grid fills the width.
Titles use the plural: 'Editar Barbeiros' / 'Novo — Serviços'. Pass a singular label.
The fullscreen preview has no visible close (X) button and closes only on tap.
The toast covers the screen header and title ('Meus Agendamentos') for about 2s. Acceptable, but consider offsetting it below the header.
The Pomada and Shampoo images show barber tools, not the products. Low priority.

action_items: Fix slot_span to respect the lunch gap: a service must not span non-contiguous slots (11:30 + 60min must be unavailable and rejected with 400).
Add Pydantic constraints: status Literal['Ativo','Inativo'], preco/estoque/duracao >= 0.
Format currency in pt-BR (R$ 45,00) across the app.
Home reminder: exclude bookings from today whose time has already passed.
Optional: singular titles in the CRUD modal, close button on the galeria preview, a slot grid that fills the width.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 886 lines (over 700). Consider splitting the routers (auth, catalog, agendamentos, admin).
Hooks order in booking.tsx and barbeiro/[id].tsx is correct (all hooks run before the Redirect early-return).
CrudScreen uses KeyboardAwareScrollView inside the Modal, so keyboard handling is OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor UX/design issues only)

seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ barbeiros/servicos, test_* users and their bookings were all deleted from MongoDB after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported and the default xdist (a full-suite '-n 0' run timed out once; test_iteration2_fixes.py alone with -n 0 runs in about 9s). Server TZ is UTC; the backend uses America/Sao_Paulo. In Playwright, use normal click() with scroll_into_view_if_needed for booking-day chips inside the horizontal ScrollView, because force=True clicks did not register. Day chips and slots render only after a servico and a barbeiro are selected. Agenda rows open the options-sheet on tap. The admin's own row in usuarios is disabled. If a test run is killed, run tests/cleanup_test_data.py.
rca_of_issue: Lunch-gap bug: DEFAULT_SLOTS lists 11:30 then 13:00, and slot_span slices DEFAULT_SLOTS[i:i+n], treating them as contiguous. Mitigation: compute the needed times as start + 30*k minutes and check membership in DEFAULT_SLOTS.
